JOYSTAR Unicorn 20Inch Girls' Bike with Doll Seat & Basket
Ride into a world of magic with the JOYSTAR Unicorn 20inch Girls' Bike. Adorned with vibrant colors and delightful unicorn decals, this bike is built to provide a safe, stable, and enchanting riding experience for girls aged 6 to 10 years old.

Make every ride magical: The JOYSTAR Unicorn with DIY decals and doll carrier.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Crafted with a focus on stability and ease of use, the Unicorn series ensures your child's first miles are filled with confidence and joy."
Safety-First Construction
The Unicorn bike features a rugged Hi-Ten steel frame and fork, designed to survive the bumps of learning. Safety is enhanced with a dual-braking system: a rear coaster brake for easy stopping by pedaling backwards and a front caliper brake to help young riders learn hand-controlled stopping power.

Heavy-duty training wheels and a fully enclosed chain guard for maximum protection.

Kid-Centric Features

Reliable Stopping: Combination of front handbrake and rear coaster brake for versatile control.

Smooth Ride: Wide 2.125" pneumatic tires offer better balance and shock absorption on pavement or gravel.

Adjustable Fit: Tool-free quick-release seat post allows the bike to grow alongside your child.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Setting up your new JOYSTAR is a breeze. This bike comes 85% pre-assembled. Just follow our simple steps to attach the handlebars, front wheel, pedals, and accessories.

Watch: Quick assembly guide to get her on the road in no time.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Adventure awaits: See the Unicorn bike in action!

Our Guarantee
We stand by our quality. Every JOYSTAR Unicorn Bike is backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty on the frame and a 30-day satisfaction guarantee. Ride with peace of mind knowing we've got you covered.
